nodes.title: Double ascent–double descent generating function of a pair of patterns

nodes.summary: Given a bijection $v$ from $\{0, 1, 2\}$ to itself, this is the permutation of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ that sends $i$ to $v(i)$. The values are listed zero-based, so $v = (0, 2, 1)$ gives the pattern $132$ in the usual one-based one-line notation.
nodes.title: Length-three pattern from one-line values

nodes.summary: Writing permutations of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ in one-based one-line notation, the identity $123$ has two ascents and no descents, $\operatorname{asc}(123) = 2$ and $\operatorname{des}(123) = 0$, and $132$ has one of each, $\operatorname{asc}(132) = \operatorname{des}(132) = 1$.
nodes.title: Ascents and descents of $123$ and $132$

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$, $\operatorname{asc}(\sigma)$ is the number of positions $i$ with $i + 1 < n$ and $\sigma(i) < \sigma(i + 1)$.
nodes.title: Ascent number of a permutation

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$, $\operatorname{des}(\sigma)$ is the number of positions $i$ with $i + 1 < n$ and $\sigma(i + 1) < \sigma(i)$.
nodes.title: Descent number of a permutation

nodes.summary: Writing permutations of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ in one-based one-line notation, and $\operatorname{dasc}$, $\operatorname{ddes}$, $\operatorname{pk}$ and $\operatorname{vl}$ for the numbers of double ascents, double descents, peaks and valleys, $\operatorname{dasc}(123) = 1$, $\operatorname{ddes}(321) = 1$, $\operatorname{dasc}(132) = \operatorname{ddes}(132) = 0$, $\operatorname{pk}(132) = 1$, $\operatorname{vl}(132) = 0$,…
nodes.title: Double ascents, double descents, peaks and valleys in length three

nodes.summary: Writing permutations of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ in one-based one-line notation, $132$ has $2$ left-to-right maxima, $2$ right-to-left maxima, $1$ left-to-right minimum and $2$ right-to-left minima, and $213$ has $2$ left-to-right maxima, $1$ right-to-left maximum, $2$ left-to-right minima and $2$ right-to-left minima.
nodes.title: Left-to-right and right-to-left extrema of $132$ and $213$

nodes.summary: Exactly $7$ permutations of $\{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ avoid both patterns $132$ and $321$, that is, $A_4(132, 321) = 7 = 1 + \binom{4}{2}$.
nodes.title: Permutations of length four avoiding $132$ and $321$
Simion–Schmidt enumeration of permutations avoiding two patterns of length three

nodes.summary: Exactly $4$ permutations of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ avoid both patterns $123$ and $132$, that is, $A_3(123, 132) = 4$: of the six permutations of length $3$, only $123$ and $132$ themselves are excluded.
nodes.title: Permutations of length three avoiding $123$ and $132$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and permutations $\tau$ and $\rho$ of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, $A_n(\tau, \rho)$ is the number of permutations of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$ that contain neither $\tau$ nor $\rho$ as a classical pattern.
nodes.title: Number of permutations avoiding two patterns of length three

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
